issues.description: Constructor declaration in the template header uses parameter types 'long' while the implementation defines the constructor with parameters of type 'int'. This mismatch between declaration and definition in the template will cause a signature/mangling mismatch (and potential linker errors or student confusion). The solution repository already uses a matching 'int' declaration, so the template's header should be corrected to match the implementation and the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor declaration in the template header match the implementation (and the solution). Change Bitmap24(long i_width, long i_height); to Bitmap24(int i_width, int i_height); in example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp (or alternatively change the implementation and related members consistently to 'long', but using 'int' is consistent with the implementation and member types).
